cohort: A total of 120 term pregnant women with no history of cesarean section, scheduled for primary cesarean section, were randomized to different uterotomy closure techniques.
finding: Baseball-type uterotomy closure significantly reduced isthmocele development and resulted in higher residual myometrial thickness compared to single-locked and single-unlocked techniques.
mod_finding: Baseball-type suturing during cesarean section is an advantageous method for preserving residual myometrial thickness and preventing isthmocele formation compared to traditional single-locked and single-unlocked techniques.
